flow: 1 Plan (2 min): one note box per cue-card point; model hidden
2 Record (60–90 s): existing speaking feedback with week context
3 Listen to the model (unlocked after the first recording): focus question, answer marked on the server
4 Notice: listen again and tap the phrases you hear (4 real, 2 not in the model); then see the model transcript with the phrases highlighted
5 Compare: model transcript beside the learner's transcript; phrases from the list that the learner used are highlighted
6 Try again (optional): record once more using two phrases; feedback says which phrases were used
